verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim stores scenes and robots in OpenUSD, an open format, and its GitHub lists asset import and export of robots and environments to non-USD formats. Import from URDF and MJCF is documented, and Isaac Lab is open source, all of which supports portability. However, export is only a one-line feature listing, and nothing documents exporting all user data or leaving the platform. missing for 10: named export target formats (e.g. URDF/MJCF export) with documentation, open-format specification for synthetic data and training outputs, an explicit full-data export/exit workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
